criteria: Recent or niche predictive models in the structured-data domain (tabular, time-series, causal inference, survival) that frontier and mid-tier LLMs reliably underweight or fail to name cold, UNLIKE well-known recent models (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, BERT, CLIP, ViT) that any LLM surfaces readily. This curated set is exactly what the model-tree tool exists to surface: the overlooked-but-fitting model the user's own LLM would forget. Maintained by id; grow it as new models appear (this is the tool's durable value: staying ahead of the LLM's training cutoff). Famous vision/NLP/generative models and well-known classics are deliberately excluded.
